head: codex/autonomous-causal-lifecycle-20261010
title: fix(autonomy): preserve causal coverage and fence protected lifecycle writers
body:
A newer unrelated same-source Sentinel could displace the authenticated Coverage continuation, while stale update and redundant close exposed write tokens without durable shared fencing. REST service failures could also leave a partial scan eligible for fanout.

Use causal continuation queues and authenticated exact-parent selection. Invalidate the entire scan on HTTP 5xx. Execute stale update and redundant close within the protected broker, with a shared repository/PR/head fence, narrow read tokens, signed readback, one mutation and permanent UNKNOWN hold. Verify public broker OIDC signatures and exact native caller identity. Finalizer token handoff shares the same fence and follows original reservation-owner checks. A shared durable 64-minute legacy-token drain gates authorization dispatch before its tuple claim, lifecycle mutation and Finalizer handoff; Finalizer observes readiness before creating a reservation.

Validation: 506/506 integrated regression tests and 31/31 broker tests passed locally; the final no-SDK-retry adjustment passed the Finalizer transport tests. Includes concurrent writers, interrupted replies, cross-operation/main drift, invalid caller identities, causal coverage selection, partial-scan failure, shared drain and post-drain dispatch reuse. Exact-head independent CI remains required.

Source commit 43c65f8c4216d883f80768b46e1bc094eb55e9ef; tree 882ec08da19e3a24fc3bc2d10b51f0bf66ef7568. The closure loop found two exact-head validation drifts after the immutable intent and repaired them in commit 9c47e1f58ab48f32ed4ea7939719ed0f571c371d: Reserve provenance now checks the strengthened exact-SHA/event/execution concurrency fence, and the Sentinel content test no longer depends on test-command ordering. Head 67c065508611c2012c3f4d963b2beab03e7c1f99 retains the historical immutable transport fixture and the negative test proving the changed live Finalizer cannot inherit that exception. Commits be4cfa0294b33fa7396784c726d51a1c3e08edff and 67c065508611c2012c3f4d963b2beab03e7c1f99 reconcile the existing Draft payload through an r4 immutable intent and derived canonical inventory without replaying proposal creation. All 29 exact-head workflows succeed, including CI Validation, Delegated Autonomous Internal Authority, Sentinel, Sharded Source Reserve, P0 Closure, and Intelligence Runtime Contract. Draft Development Validation is successful (3 exact-head contexts verified; Draft non-promotable). Governed Landing remains pending because the Draft has no protected activation authority. The r4 intent is bound to source bd271aa5f19b7c5f0152d0305cfe1c8f2fe5d205 with authority_granted=false, and the protected-source profile still requires a new exact-head Owner decision; no approval, receipt, Ready transition, dispatch, or merge authority was created. The earlier intent cannot be rebound or reused. Rollback source and matching protected pins together, preserving durable ledger records and UNKNOWN fences. Legacy minting revisions must not be reactivated during drain.

Baseline main 240cd17a5e4cf9543d54559c44a3d59a8b59bc03: natural schedule Dispatcher 38004489870 succeeded, artifact 11650368544 SHA256 4f6c9ba35e1bb73e4716c1c1be2b360bbaafc301986fed76761a88e1fa010755. It inspected 100 candidates using 219/256 requests, with zero executable lifecycle candidates. This is diagnostic scan evidence, not lifecycle or whole-platform health proof. Completed #2625/#2626/#2627/#1903/#2628/#2629 stages are consumed and will not be repeated. Existing completed dispatches blocked at cutover require reconciliation, never blind reissue.

STATE IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED(runtime). Protected source/policy activation requires a new exact-head Owner decision. Lambda Timeout 30 to 180 is an Owner-reserved non-code infrastructure change and the existing automatic no-authority-expansion validator correctly rejects it. No deployment has occurred. Deployment must additionally establish that legacy broker revisions cannot mint during or after the quiet window. New natural lifecycle readback, signed reuse and whole-authority-chain Producer Health remain unproven. This Draft grants no Ready, approval, dispatch, merge, deployment or promotion authority. Production/Public/G5/provider activation HOLD.

Root mission AUTONOMOUS_NORMAL_OPERATIONS_CLOSURE_MISSION; completion owner Atlas-KPMO. Red Team review is read-only; formal independence UNKNOWN.
autonomous_effect: bounded natural recovery and durable original-writer fencing; runtime proof pending.
global_effect: UNKNOWN; this internal correction creates no global source-universe coverage evidence.
irreplaceable_value_effect: preserve owned causal lineage, signed receipts and durable incident continuity.
transparency_effect: distinguish local verification, baseline diagnostic success, protected activation and whole-platform health.
